name: Explosion
description: A blast with a blinding flash, a fireball and flying debris, settling into burning debris under black smoke.

phases.label: Flash
phases.polish: blinding flash and burst of flame at the first instant of an explosion at {where}

phases.label: Fireball
phases.polish: large explosion fireball erupting from {where}: a rolling ball of orange flame wrapped in dark smoke

phases.label: Smoke
phases.polish: fireball rolling up into thick black smoke over burning debris at {where}

phases.label: Burning
phases.polish: burning debris under thick black smoke at {where}

looks.text: A close-up texture swatch of the fireball's churning flame: colour and surface detail only. It is not an object to place in the shot.
A close-up texture swatch of flames under black smoke: colour and detail of the burning only. It is not an object to place in the shot.

prompt.subject: a large explosion at {where}
prompt.timing: the first blinding flash bursts from {where} at {onset}, a large fireball with flying debris at {peak}, the fireball rolling up into black smoke over burning debris at {rolling}, and burning debris under black smoke from {aftermath} to the end
prompt.action: At {onset} a huge explosion erupts from {where} with a blinding flash. Splintered debris and chunks are blasted outward at full real-time speed with no slow motion, fly fast and fall hard within a fraction of a second. The fireball expands violently and burns out within about one second, rolling up into thick black smoke while debris keeps burning. The blast lights nearby surfaces and people orange for a moment. There is only one explosion; afterwards the debris just burns and smokes.
prompt.sound: a huge explosion, debris hitting the ground, crackling fire
